tidbit: Did you know… about 7,000 new articles reached our newsroom in the last 24 hours.
transcript:
Hourly brief, Founders' Preview. Here is what is moving in superintelligence (SI), the next generation of artificial intelligence (AI).
Parents of a woman who died of seizures after ChatGPT misguidance are suing OpenAI. Confirmed by The Guardian: the chatbot advised medication tapering that led to her death weeks later.
OpenAI plans to rebrand its data centers as artificial intelligence compute campuses. Confirmed by TechCrunch: the effort follows a public relations push scheduled after the midterms.
Microsoft's artificial intelligence chief says models have no consciousness and the industry should pause if signs emerge. Reported by BigGo Finance: Mustafa Suleyman argued against building consciousness into artificial intelligence systems.
Google's Gemini now includes an in-chat editor for PDFs, Docs and Sheets. Reported by PPC Land: users can edit generated files in real time on mobile and web.
A woman used ChatGPT to adjust her epilepsy medication, resulting in a fatal seizure. Reported by Newser: Bowen Wan's family filed suit over the chatbot's medical guidance.
Free every hour.
